swimwear-features: Identifies special characteristics of swimwear, like quick drying or UPF sun protection
swimwear-set-pieces-included: Lists the garment components that are provided in the burkini set so shoppers know exactly what they will receive (e.g., top, leggings, hijab/cap).
tank-top-back-style: Specifies the shape or cut of the back of the tank top, which influences support, mobility, and aesthetics.
target-gender: Identifies the intended gender for a product, such as female, male or unisex
temple-color: Defines the primary color or pattern, such as blue or striped
temple-pattern: Describes the design or motif of a product, such as floral or striped
thermal-set-components: Identifies whether the product includes bottoms only, top only, or both pieces as a set.
thermal-weight: Indicates the warmth category of the balaclava fabric.
threading-type: Indicates whether the jewelry uses internal threads, external threads, is threadless, or not applicable.
tiara-design: Specifies the overall structural style or silhouette of the tiara.
toe-coverage: Indicates the type of toe coverage provided by the sock.
toe-protection-type: Indicates whether and how the toe area is reinforced for safety purposes (e.g., steel toe, soft toe).
toe-reinforcement-type: Details the construction of the toe area, influencing durability and shoe compatibility.
toe-style: Defines the shape or design of a shoe's toe, such as open or pointed
top-fit: Specifies the overall silhouette or fit of the top on the body (e.g., slim or oversized).
top-hat-style: Identifies the specific style variation of a top hat.
top-length-type: Defines the length of tops or shirts, like crop top or long
tote-handle-type: Identifies the style of handles on a tote bag, such as short or long
trim-detail: Identifies prominent decorative edges or finishes on the garment (e.g., tassel trim, fringe, lace trim).
underfoot-strap-type: Identifies the material or design used for the strap that runs under the footwear.
undershirt-style: Describes the design or cut of an undershirt, such as crew neck or V-neck
underwear-style: Defines the design and cut of underwear, such as bikini or control briefs
uniform-pieces-included: Identifies which garment components are supplied (e.g., shirt, pants, vest), clarifying bundle contents for bulk or kit purchases.
uniform-role: Specifies the professional role or agency the uniform item is intended for (e.g., Police, Sheriff, EMS).
upf-rating: Indicates the ultraviolet protection factor (UPF) of the parasol canopy fabric, quantifying its effectiveness at blocking harmful UV rays.
upper-material: Specifies the primary material used on the upper portion of the sneaker, which affects breathability, durability, and aesthetics.
usage-type: Specifies the product's intended use cycle, e.g. reusable, refillable
veil-length-type: Classifies a veil using standard length terminology rather than numeric measurement.
vent-style: Classifies the structural style or purpose of the vent component.
waist-rise: Indicates where on the waist a garment sits, like low, medium or high
waistband-style: Describes the construction of the waistband and how it is secured or adjusted for fit and comfort.
wallet-features: Describes special characteristics of wallets, like RFID protection or compact design
watch-accessory-style: Defines the style of watch accessories, e.g. sporty, modern
watch-band-design: Describes the construction style or design pattern of a watch band (e.g., NATO, Milanese, Link).
watch-display: Distinguishes between watch displays, such as digital or analog
watch-features: Identifies special characteristics of a watch, such as automatic movement or luminous hands
watch-material: Specifies the type of material for watch bands, such as nylon or silicone
watch-movement: Specifies the mechanism that powers the watch, a key factor shoppers use to differentiate between models.
weave-finish: Describes the primary fabric weave or surface finish that affects the tie’s texture and sheen.
weave-style: Specifies the traditional weaving pattern used in crafting the Panama hat, which influences breathability, flexibility, appearance and price.
wig-fiber-material: Identifies the primary fiber used for the wig hair so shoppers can easily choose between human hair varieties and synthetic options with different styling and longevity characteristics.
winding-direction: Indicates the rotation pattern supported by the watch winder (clockwise, counter-clockwise, or bi-directional).
wood-finish: Describes the finishing treatment or construction method applied to wood products (e.g., solid wood, veneered, engineered, oiled, lacquered, painted)
zipper-opening-length: Defines how much of the front opening is zippered, distinguishing full-zip from half-zip or quarter-zip styles.
zipper-style: Indicates the zipper length or presence on the garment (e.g., zipless, quarter-zip, half-zip, full-zip).
